source_snapshot.criteria: HMC can successfully communicate with I2C devices on first HPM.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_HMCbus1; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for HMC/BMC ownership and proxy semantics, exact controller/mux/first-HPM topology, device oracle, safe transactions, photos and recovery.

old_problem: The proposed BMC I2C-1 command may access a physically unrelated bus. The project does not establish whether HMC is the controller, whether BMC is an authorized proxy to that exact HMC path, or which endpoint/mux provides target-bound first-HPM evidence.
disposition_reason: Controller/access-path identity is part of the test's core semantics: evidence from a similarly numbered BMC bus cannot be accepted for an explicitly HMC-owned path without an authoritative proxy mapping. Parameterizing device addresses does not solve an unknown execution surface. The ownership/proxy and required recovery must be approved before a valid command can be authored, so Pending remains.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2161, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2162 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00049-V002 / 562fb87b2bccde55 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Owner must establish HMC versus BMC bus ownership and either a native HMC endpoint or a specification-backed BMC proxy to the exact HMC I2C-1 path.
After ownership is known, bind controller/adapter/mux/channel/first-HPM connector, approved 1P population and first-HPM identity allowlist.
Operator physical inspection/photos remain mandatory; they cannot make an unmapped management command target-correct.
No literal I2C-1 assumption, independent BMC/host substitution, generic scan, unknown register access, write, reset or automatic retry is allowed.
Preserve HMC/BMC/bus logs and stop on wrong-path response, topology ambiguity, timeout, stuck bus or management instability.
No HMC/BMC query, physical manipulation, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HMC-owned I2C-1 first-HPM 1P physical and identity validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the authoritative HMC I2C-1 path is physically connected to the first HPM in the approved 1P state and safely returns every required target-bound device identity.
required_package: Approved HMC/BMC ownership and native-HMC or exact proxy access specification
HMC controller/adapter/mux/channel/first-HPM connector map and 1P population
First-HPM device address and read-safe identity register/value allowlist
Operator physical inspection/photo procedure and trusted management access
Management/bus error limits, abort and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending Engineering Decision. Perform no bus query until HMC ownership and the authoritative native/proxy access path are approved. Then operator proves the physical 1P/first-HPM connection and only the signed HMC-path read-only identity method may collect complete target-bound responses and bus-health evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The approved HMC path, 1P population and physical connection are proven; every expected first-HPM identity is returned on that exact path with clean HMC/BMC/bus health and no wrong-path substitution.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until controller/access identity is authoritative. PASS requires physical proof plus complete HMC-path identity reconciliation. FAIL on wrong path, missing/mismatched device or bus/management fault. Missing ownership/proxy remains BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until HMC ownership/proxy, topology, safe allowlist and recovery are signed.
Physical work is operator-only under the service procedure.
No unmapped BMC/host substitution, generic scan, unknown read, write, blind reset or automatic retry.
Stop on ownership ambiguity, wrong-path response, timeout, stuck bus, error storm or HMC/BMC instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and HMC/BMC ownership/proxy diagram
Approved 1P population and first-HPM connector photos
HMC endpoint/controller/mux/channel/connector map and identity allowlist
Exact approved method with access-path proof and complete response comparison
Pre/post HMC/BMC/I2C error and management-health records
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on any wrong-path or bus fault. Use only the approved HMC/BMC recovery for the mapped path; do not probe, write or blindly reset. Quarantine and escalate if ownership or restored management state cannot be proven.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently names HMC I2C-1 and the first HPM; the BMC-console suggestion is non-authoritative review text and is rejected absent a proxy mapping.
